project_type: Plane fork monorepo: Next.js web app (apps/web), Django REST API (apps/api), shared packages (packages/types, packages/i18n, packages/ui, packages/propel). Fork adds a service-desk work log / billing feature ('apontamentos').
build_system: pnpm + turbo. node is NOT on PATH by default: it lives under /root/.nvm/versions/node/* and tools/agent-sandbox/run-web-checks.sh puts it on PATH and enables corepack/pnpm itself. node_modules is not installed yet, so the first run of that script does `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (slow). Python API deps are installed into a venv outside the repo by tools/agent-sandbox/run-api-tests.sh (state dir ../.plane-agent-sandbox).
test_framework: pytest for apps/api (tests live in apps/api/plane/tests/{unit,contract,smoke}, fixtures in apps/api/plane/tests/conftest.py and factories.py; conventions in apps/api/plane/tests/TESTING_GUIDE.md). No JS unit test runner for apps/web in this module: the web-side checks are i18n key parity, tsc typecheck and oxlint.
build_command: ./tools/agent-sandbox/run-web-checks.sh types   (builds packages/* first when packages/*/dist is missing; use REBUILD=1 after editing packages/*/src)
test_command: ./tools/agent-sandbox/run-api-tests.sh <pytest args>   (e.g. ./tools/agent-sandbox/run-api-tests.sh plane/tests/unit/utils/test_service_log_time.py). Docker path (docker-compose-test.yml) is documented in AGENTS.md but the sandbox only has rootless podman, which cannot publish ports, so the native fallback is the working path.
verification_instructions:
From docs/worklog/CONVENCOES-DE-TRABALHO.md, the checks that must pass before any PR (there is NO CI in this fork, local checks are the only verification):
1. ./tools/agent-sandbox/run-api-tests.sh <paths or -m unit>   (add RECREATE_DB=1 only after a model change; no model changes are expected in this task)
2. ./tools/agent-sandbox/run-web-checks.sh types
3. ruff check apps/api   (NEVER run `ruff format`: dozens of pre-existing files fail it and reformatting creates unrelated churn)
4. ./tools/agent-sandbox/run-web-checks.sh i18n   (locale key parity)
5. ./tools/agent-sandbox/run-web-checks.sh lint <paths touched>   (oxlint; the husky pre-commit hook fails on ANY oxlint warning in a staged file)
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in for this module. packages/*/dist build output is generated and gitignored; rebuild with `pnpm turbo run build --filter='./packages/*'` (run-web-checks.sh types does it automatically, or force with REBUILD=1).
setup_instructions: 1. ./setup.sh once (generates apps/api/.env from .env.example) before running API tests. 2. First ./tools/agent-sandbox/run-web-checks.sh invocation installs node_modules. 3. First ./tools/agent-sandbox/run-api-tests.sh invocation starts native Postgres on port 5433 and Redis on 6380 and creates the Python 3.12 venv.
environment_constraints: Network mode OPEN_INTERNET, so pnpm/pip installs work. Ports 5432 and 6379 are unreachable in this sandbox (the scripts use 5433/6380). Rootless podman cannot publish ports, so `docker compose -f docker-compose-test.yml` is NOT a viable path; use tools/agent-sandbox/*. pytest.ini sets both --reuse-db and --nomigrations, so a stale test DB shows up as 'column ... does not exist' walls after model changes (RECREATE_DB=1 fixes it). No browser/device farm available: responsive behaviour must be verified by reading the Tailwind class output and reasoning about breakpoints, not by screenshots.
contribution_requirements: docs/worklog/CONVENCOES-DE-TRABALHO.md governs this feature: branch from an up-to-date `preview` (the repo default branch), one coherent change per branch, local checks are the only verification, `ruff check` yes / `ruff format` no, and tests that assert an absence must assert the reason for the absence. The master product rules are in .kiro/steering/worklog-contexto.md (R1-R11) and the decision log is docs/worklog/DECISOES.md (D1-D67). R3 ('persistir decimal, exibir legivel') and R11 (which quantity each role may see) are the two rules this task touches; R11 must not be weakened: a client must never gain access to logged_hours, the raw duration or the multiplier.
key_patterns: Hour quantities are persisted as Decimal(10,4) and are NEVER parsed into JS numbers; the API sends a `<field>_display` twin already rendered in pt-BR and the browser renders that string verbatim (packages/types/src/service-log.ts documents this). Formatting helpers all live in apps/api/plane/utils/service_log_time.py: format_duration(minutes) -> '1h 15min', format_hours(Decimal) -> '1,25h' (decimal notation), format_hours_human(Decimal) -> '1h 15min' (added in commit d5bd45b9f, rounds to the nearest minute with ROUND_HALF_UP). Money uses format_money in apps/api/plane/utils/service_money.py. Frontend styling is Tailwind with fork tokens: border-subtle, bg-surface-1/2, bg-custom-background-80/90, text-custom-text-100/200/300/350/400, bg-custom-primary-100. The established responsive pattern in this fork is in apps/web/core/components/service-reports/*: `grid grid-cols-2 gap-6 ... md:grid-cols-4`. i18n keys live in packages/i18n/src/locales/<locale>/work-item.json and every locale must carry the same keys.
directory_structure: apps/web/core/components/service-logs/ = the work item work log UI (section orchestrator, totals cards, allowance indicator, list item, form, modals, client-facing read-only section). apps/web/core/components/service-reports/ = dashboards and portal reports that render the same *_display hour strings. apps/web/core/store/issue/issue-details/service-log.store.ts + service-allowance store = MobX slices. apps/api/plane/utils/service_*.py = the domain layer (time arithmetic, allowance, pool, pricing, reports, portal projections). apps/api/plane/app/serializers/service_*.py + apps/api/plane/app/views/service_log/ = the API boundary. apps/api/plane/tests/{unit,contract,smoke} = pytest suite. tools/agent-sandbox/ = the scripts that make builds and tests runnable in this sandbox.

confirmed_findings.why_the_user_still_sees_decimals: The human-format work of commits d5bd45b9f..fd81e0a07 is present but only covers PART of the surfaces. Remaining decimal renderings, all confirmed by reading the code: (1) apps/api/plane/app/serializers/service_log.py:257 get_equivalent_hours_display -> format_hours, which is the technician list line 'o cliente ve 1,875h'; (2) the same method at line 404 on the client row serializer, which is the value the client sees per row; (3) apps/api/plane/utils/service_portal.py:510 issue_client_totals -> format_hours, which produces the client section's 'Horas consumidas' card, the most likely source of the reported '32,25h' (32,25h == 32h 15min exactly); (4) apps/api/plane/utils/service_allowance.py:987 ledger entry hours_display; (5) apps/api/plane/utils/service_pool.py:1791-1809 and apps/api/plane/utils/service_reports.py:227,820 for the dashboards. Additionally the /preview endpoint (apps/api/plane/app/views/service_log/base.py:509-518) builds totals with NO _display twins, and apps/web/core/components/service-logs/service-log-form.tsx:322 renders the RAW decimal string preview.totals.logged_hours ('1.2500'), and apps/web/core/store/issue/issue-details/service-log.store.ts:22-24 seeds EMPTY_TOTALS displays as '0h' while the backend now renders zero as '0min'. A stale deployment on planedev.satziack.com is also plausible (.github/workflows/build-branch.yml is workflow_dispatch only), but these code paths are real and must be fixed.
confirmed_findings.responsiveness_causes: apps/web/core/components/service-logs/service-log-totals.tsx:69 uses `grid gap-2 ${cards.length === 4 ? 'grid-cols-4' : 'grid-cols-3'}` with no breakpoint, so 3-4 cards are forced side by side at 390px and both label and value clip or wrap. apps/web/core/components/service-logs/service-allowance-indicator.tsx:102 uses `grid grid-cols-3 gap-2` with no breakpoint, and its header row (line 64) is `flex items-center justify-between gap-2` so the long title collides with the '161% consumido' badge. apps/web/core/components/service-logs/service-log-section.tsx header is `flex items-center justify-between` holding up to four Buttons (Editar, Excluir, Bolsa, Adicionar) with no wrapping. apps/web/core/components/service-logs/service-log-list-item.tsx right-hand cluster is `flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1` with up to four badges plus two icon buttons, competing with the text block on the same row. apps/web/core/components/service-logs/service-log-form.tsx uses `flex gap-3` (no flex-col fallback) for the interval time pair and for the hour-type/billing-type dropdown pair. apps/web/core/components/issues/peek-overview/view.tsx:171 gives the side-peek/modal content `px-8 py-5` at every width (64px of horizontal padding out of a 390px viewport) and the full-screen mode's right rail is a hard `!w-[400px]`.
